svg.title: Moki architecture
svg.desc: A browser reaches a Node server through a private gateway. The server runs agent turns and one build at a time. Narrow model agents share one plan, code gates check it, and subprocess workers produce the board, case and firmware. Agents read a parts catalog, datasheets and a block library. Datasheet layout parsing on Modal and per-build micro-VMs on Fly.io are proposed, not built.

g.text: Blue landing and project gallery, with server-rendered thumbnails
Project studio: schematic canvas with editing, plus PCB, 3D, Case and Firmware tabs

svg.text: HTTPS: JSON, build files, SSE events

g.text: Sogo Apps gateway: a private, authenticated link

svg.text: APIs are Vite plugins in server/

g.text: Saved as JSON and files in var/
One build at a time, up to 5 waiting

svg.text: the job API the studio uses

g.text: One shared plan, the source of truth

svg.text: A failed gate stops the build, or goes to the Fixer for at most 2 tries

g.text: A micro-VM per build, on Fly.io
